column1: # Table S1. Genus-level differential abundance between clean- and muck-reared siblings: all 328 genus-level features with reads in the 26 reared animals.

# Statistic T = sum over litters of the within-litter Mann-Whitney U (Muck > Clean pairs; ties 0.5), evaluated under all 211680 within-litter treatment assignments; P is exact, two-sided; q = Benjamini-Hochberg across the 328 features.
# Means are percentages of reads (unrarefied filtered table); carriers = animals with at least one read (of 16 Clean, 10 Muck); log2FC = log2[(mean Muck + c)/(mean Clean + c)] with c = 1.564e-5.
